songs.title: Tumi Robe Nirobe

songs.title: Bhalobeshe Shokhi Nibhrite Jotone

songs.title: Aaji Banglader Hridoy Hote

songs.title: Megh Boleche Jabo Jabo

songs.title: Amar Matha Nato Kore Dao

songs.title: Phule Phule Dhole Dhole

songs.title: Aamar Shonar Desh Re

songs.title: Biday

songs.title: Nil Digante

songs.title: Ami Chini Go Chini Tomare

songs.title: Bajao Bajao

songs.fun_fact: Sung at Rabindra Jayanti (Tagore's birthday) celebrations every year.

songs.title: Tomar Holo Shuru

songs.title: Rongino Sheje Jai

songs.title: Praner Khushi

songs.title: Chokhe Ami Chini Tomay

songs.fun_fact: A favourite among Tagore's romantic compositions (Prem Paryay).

songs.title: Nishi Raat Baoka Chand

songs.fun_fact: One of the most loved Nazrul romantic compositions (Prem Geeti).

songs.title: Shongkochero Bihwolata

songs.title: Tomari Tore Ei Jibon

songs.title: Sympathy for the Devil

songs.title: Aqualung

songs.title: Wish You Were Here

songs.title: Comfortably Numb
